blocks.text: Setting up Google Sheets on your Mac

Google Sheets does not have a native Mac app. It runs in your browser. To make it feel like a real app, use the Progressive Web App feature in Chrome. Open sheets.google.com, click the three dot menu in the top right, select Cast, Save, and Share, then click Install page as app. This creates a dedicated icon in your Launchpad or Applications folder. It opens in its own window without browser tabs getting in your way.

Speed is vital when you are managing project schedules. Press ⌘ + / at any time to see a full list of keyboard shortcuts. Use ⌘ + ⇧ + H to open the Find and Replace tool. To hide rows, select them and press ⌘ + ⌥ + 9. To hide columns, use ⌘ + ⌥ + 0. If you cannot find a specific menu item, press ⌥ + / to open the Tool Finder and type what you need.

Coordinators often deal with massive project lists. Google Sheets now supports up to 20 million cells. If your sheet starts lagging, check for complex formulas or circular references. Use the Filter feature to focus on specific project phases. You can also freeze the top row so your headers stay visible as you scroll down through long task lists.

blocks.text: How Lazur helps you inside Google Sheets

Lazur acts as your personal assistant while you work. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about any feature on your screen. If you are stuck on a formula, ask Lazur to explain how it works. When you need to find a button, ask Lazur where it is and watch as it draws a circle around the exact menu item.

faq.question: Is there an official Google Sheets app for Mac?
faq.answer: No, there is no official standalone app. You should use the Progressive Web App method in Chrome to create a shortcut that behaves like an app.

faq.question: How do I fix formula errors in my project sheet?
faq.answer: Check your cell ranges and ensure you are using the correct punctuation. If you are confused, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur to explain the formula syntax.

faq.question: Can I use Google Sheets offline on my Mac?
faq.answer: Yes, you can enable offline access in your Google Drive settings while using the Chrome browser.
